raw:
Agent Name: Planner  
Step Number: 1  
Reason for Mistake: The Planner did not correctly disambiguate the identity of the director Fernando Cortés. It incorrectly identified him as the Mexican director of "My Three Merry Widows" (1953), while the actual Fernando Cortés associated with the film was Puerto Rican and married to Mapy Cortés. This oversight led to the propagation of incorrect assumptions throughout the subsequent steps, as the error was never corrected. The Planner should have verified the nationality and identity of Fernando Cortés early on to ensure the correct individual was being investigated.
